releases.notes:
BatteryCraft beta.5 gives you more control over battery profiles: lower FPS caps stay lower, and detected manual graphics edits are preserved.

### Lower FPS caps stay lower

- Profiles now use the lower of your original Minecraft cap and their configured cap by default. **Original 60 + profile 120 → 60 FPS cap.**
- Enable **Allow profiles to raise the FPS cap** to explicitly permit a higher cap. Available in Sodium General settings and the fallback configuration window, in English and Spanish.
- A profile cap of **0** retains your original cap. Detected manual FPS edits still take priority.

### Your manual changes are protected

- BatteryCraft tracks each managed setting separately, comparing its current value with the last value applied by the mod.
- Detected edits remain under your control through battery, low-battery and critical-battery transitions and reconnection. Untouched settings continue to follow profiles and restore normally.
- Reconnecting in Automatic mode or disabling saving ends the saving session. Your retained settings become the baseline for the next session.

### Recovery and upgrades

- Recovery snapshots now store original values, last-applied values and detected manual overrides, protecting saved edits after an unexpected close.
- Existing beta.4 recovery snapshots remain readable.
- Configuration migration preserves custom profiles and notification preferences.
- Profile-change messages no longer display a requested cap as if it were the effective FPS cap.

### Four Minecraft builds

| Minecraft | Java | Minimum Fabric Loader | Download |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.21.x | 21 | 0.16.0 | `batterycraft-1.0.0-beta.5-mc1.21.jar` |
| 26.1.x | 25 | 0.19.0 | `batterycraft-1.0.0-beta.5-mc26.1.jar` |
| 26.2.x | 25 | 0.19.3 | `batterycraft-1.0.0-beta.5-mc26.2.jar` |
| 26.3.x | 25 | 0.19.5 | `batterycraft-1.0.0-beta.5-mc26.3.jar` |

macOS, client-side only. Install Fabric API matching your Minecraft version. A compatible Sodium Config API enables the native menu; otherwise the fallback window and configurable B/O shortcuts remain available.

### Validation

- **32 automated tests passed**, covering lower caps, explicit opt-in, manual edits, profile transitions, fresh sessions, crash recovery, legacy snapshots and named/intermediary option access. Native-menu regression tests use Sodium 0.8.12's real builders.
- All four JARs were built and checked for version metadata, Java bytecode, translations and ZIP integrity.
- **The maintainer reported a successful in-game test on Minecraft 26.3.** Exact patch and dependency versions were not recorded in that report. Specific beta.5 in-game validation for 1.21.x, 26.1.x and 26.2.x remains pending.
- FPS and battery-life improvements have not been benchmarked. A cap is not a guaranteed frame rate.

### Installation and detection limits

Close Minecraft and replace the previous BatteryCraft JAR with the file for your version; avoid duplicate installations.

Detection requires a value different from the last applied value, including changes made by other mods. Same-value edits or edits reverted before the next application/restoration cannot be distinguished. Unsaved Minecraft edits cannot be recovered after restarting. Legacy beta.4 snapshots lack the last-applied values needed to identify edits made before upgrading.

releases.notes:
BatteryCraft 1.0.0-beta.4 brings native Sodium video-settings pages, quieter battery reminders, and configurable profiles that prioritize lighter rendering.

- Find BatteryCraft under Options > Video Settings with a compatible Sodium Config API. All 36 options use Sodium’s Apply/cancel flow, with English and Spanish labels and tooltips.
- Periodic battery messages are disabled by default, including when upgrading from beta.3. Configure minutes and extra seconds, such as 15 minutes + 0 seconds or 30 minutes + 0 seconds.
- New default FPS caps: 120 on battery, 90 on low battery, and 60 on critical battery, with lower rendering and simulation distances. Custom profiles are preserved.
- The control now reads “Maximum FPS on battery.” Zero keeps Minecraft’s original cap; it does not necessarily mean unlimited FPS.
- Connecting external power in Automatic mode restores the original settings. Smart Recovery protects those settings across unexpected shutdowns.
- Includes the alpha.2 startup fix: Sodium groups and pages are attached only after their contents are populated.

Validation: 21 automated tests passed, including regression coverage using Sodium 0.8.12’s actual builders. All three target JARs were built and their versions and translations checked. The maintainer confirmed the corrected menu works in Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabulously Optimized and Sodium 0.8.12. FPS and autonomy gains have not been benchmarked; FPS caps are not guaranteed frame rates.

Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API, close Minecraft, and replace the previous BatteryCraft JAR with the matching file. Minecraft 1.21.x requires Java 21; 26.1.x and 26.2.x require Java 25. The native menu needs a compatible Sodium Config API.

### Minecraft 26.3 build added — September 20, 2026

- Added `batterycraft-1.0.0-beta.4-mc26.3.jar`, retaining beta.4's profiles and features.
- Requires Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API for Minecraft 26.3.
- Adapts B/O shortcuts to SDL keyboard types/codes and notifications to 26.3's chat/overlay methods.
- Use the dedicated 26.3 JAR; the 26.2 JAR declares compatibility only with 26.2.x.
- Validation: 24 automated tests passed; all four target JARs built; the new JAR's metadata and ZIP integrity were verified. Relevant Minecraft 26.3 and Sodium 0.9.2 API signatures were inspected. In-game validation on 26.3 remains pending.

Source for the added 26.3 build: [f07008616c3691b827f93f5d5f00380492d6cd7c](https://github.com/benjamincalledur10-bit/BatteryCraft/commit/f07008616c3691b827f93f5d5f00380492d6cd7c). The original release tag and existing JARs are unchanged; GitHub's automatic source archives still correspond to the original tag.

releases.notes:
Updated September 6, 2026: fixed the startup crash caused by attaching empty option groups to Sodium pages. The alpha.2 tag now points to the corrected commit, and all three JAR assets have been replaced. If you downloaded alpha.2 earlier, download it again and replace the previous JAR.

BatteryCraft now appears in Sodium’s Video Settings sidebar, with native General, Notifications, Battery, Low battery, and Critical battery pages.

- Configure all 36 editable options inside Minecraft using Sodium’s Apply/cancel flow.
- Set notification intervals in minutes and extra seconds, including 15 or 30 minutes.
- Edit power profiles, FPS caps, rendering distances, thresholds, and other settings with English/Spanish labels and tooltips.
- The native menu does not depend on or register the old B/O key bindings. The legacy configuration fallback remains available without Sodium’s Config API.
- Uses Sodium’s optional public Config API, checked against the published 0.8.12 API for Minecraft 1.21.11.

Validation: 21 automated tests passed, including a regression test against Sodium 0.8.12’s real builders that reproduced the original crash and validates all five pages and 36 options; three target JARs built and packaging verified. The native menu still requires visual validation in game, and FPS/battery-life improvements have not been benchmarked.

The Git tag is `v1.0.0-alpha.2`; mod metadata and JAR filenames remain `1.0.0-beta.4`, continuing the beta.4 preview series.

Installation: close Minecraft, replace the previous BatteryCraft JAR with the file matching your Minecraft version, and restart. With a compatible Sodium Config API installed, open Options > Video Settings > BatteryCraft.

Requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API. Minecraft 1.21.x requires Java 21; 26.1.x and 26.2.x require Java 25.

releases.notes:
## BatteryCraft 1.0.0 beta.3 - Smart Recovery

### Highlights

- Added **Smart Recovery**, which preserves the player's original Minecraft settings while a power-saving profile is active.
- BatteryCraft can now restore those settings after an unexpected shutdown or crash.
- Added the estimated macOS battery time to the optional in-game HUD.

### Profiles and HUD

- Added a configurable transition delay to prevent rapid profile switching.
- Critical-battery mode still activates immediately for safety.
- Added a configurable HUD refresh interval.
- The HUD now shows the active profile, battery percentage, and estimated remaining time when available.

### Interface and diagnostics

- Added automatic English and Spanish localization to the configuration interface.
- Added a diagnostics panel for macOS detection, CPU architecture, Sodium, thermal state, battery information, and recovery status.
- Increased the configuration window size for the new controls.

### Reliability

- Recovery snapshots are stored safely and removed automatically after restoration.
- Existing beta.2 configurations receive the new options with safe defaults.
- Expanded automated tests for recovery, transition stability, configuration migration, and macOS battery parsing.

### Compatibility

- **Minecraft 1.21.x:** Java 21
- **Minecraft 26.1.x:** Java 25
- **Minecraft 26.2.x:** Java 25
- Fabric API is required.
- Client-side macOS mod; no server installation is required.
